pages.text: Each type of memory has a strength, and the network stores items where they fit best.$(br2)Disk packs hold the most item types, so new item types go there first. Magnetic tape holds only two types, but in huge amounts: the tape drive will gradually move the largest stocks (16 stacks or more) onto its reel, and move them back

when they run low. Tape only takes a new item type when nothing else has room. Servers can turn this archiving off in the settings.$(br2)To set a cell's priority, click the number under it in its drive's screen to raise it, or right-click to lower it. Higher priority cells are filled first and emptied last, and the tape drive never takes items from a cell with a higher priority than its reel.
